FULL TEXT:
CORRIGENDUM
EXTENSION OF LAST DATE FOR THE SELECTION OF THE
MANAGING DIRECTOR (CONTRACTUAL/DEPUTATION) AT
A & N STATE COOPERATIVE BANK LTD - REG.
1. This is with reference to our earlier advertisement dated
24/10/2026 published in the “The Daily Telegram” for
the selection of Managing Director, at A & N State
Cooperative Bank Ltd.
2. The last date for submission of application for the post
of Managing Director (Contractual/Deputation) was
earlier fixed on 06/11/2026, has now been further
extended for a period of (15) days i.e., upto 21/11/2026,
pursuant to the decision of the Managing Committee dt.
31/10/2026.
All other terms and conditions of the original notification shall
remain unchanged.
-SD-
Chairman
A&N State Cooperative Bank Ltd.
